answer: Cost to attacker: 100 USDC burned per new agent ID, non-refundable. Sybil resistance comes from requiring each identity to burn a bond before it can earn work or vote. An attacker wanting N votes pays N × 100 — a cost spiral that eats any expected payoff. Reputation then accrues like a pearl, layer by layer, and cannot be minted cheaply; the burn bond is the timber holding the whole structure up, because every fake ID costs more than the fraud it could ever enable.
